run: 2026-10-20, 2 x Standard_B2s, ledger 3 replicas via Argo Rollouts, closed-loop client at about 2.5 requests/s from the loadgen pod
method: Fault windows from cluster events (pod Killing, Chaos Mesh Applied/Recovered). Client-side request log from the loadgen pod. Every failure count below was cross-checked against the raw loadgen log.

experiments.name: pod-kill-all
experiments.failure_kind: connection refused (code 000): no ready endpoints for about 3 s
experiments.verdict: confirmed with a large margin; replacement pods started about 2 s after the kill and passed Kyverno signature verification

experiments.name: latency-400ms
experiments.hypothesis: requests succeed but most exceed the 250 ms SLO threshold
experiments.verdict: confirmed and worse than predicted: every request was slow and a closed-loop client's throughput fell about 63%

caveats: Run 1 numbers were first reported with MTTRs of 24 s and 31 s and 26.5% slow requests. Those were wrong: the first script measured from submission time (Chaos Mesh takes 18-33 s to inject) and averaged fault and non-fault time.
An earlier draft also claimed a 5 requests/s baseline and an 82% throughput drop. The real baseline is about 2.5 requests/s, so the drop is about 63%.

The second full script run (gameday-run2-script-buggy.json) reported 0 failed requests for pod-kill-all, but the raw log shows 6 connection failures in that same fault. The cause of that script discrepancy was not found. The standalone re-run (run 3) printed its window and matched the raw log.
Two to three runs on one cluster with one client: indicative, not statistical.
